definitions.explanation: Food cooked personally by someone at home, as opposed to store-bought, restaurant, or catered food. Emphasizes the personal effort and care put into cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手料理|てりょうり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{恋|こい}しい→恋しい：03055_koishii⟧。
examples.english: I miss my mother's home cooking.

examples.japanese: {手料理|てりょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}った→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧。
⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招|まね}いて→招く：02425_maneku⟧、{手料理|てりょうり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦もてなした→もてなす：10635_motenasu⟧。
examples.english: I invited a friend to my home and treated them to my home cooking.

notes:
{手料理|てりょうり} emphasizes the personal touch and effort of cooking at home. It is often used warmly, suggesting care and affection.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手料理|てりょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧: to serve homemade food
- {手料理|てりょうり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦もてなす→もてなす：10635_motenasu⟧: to entertain with homemade food
- ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手料理|てりょうり}: mother's home cooking
- {手料理|てりょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a home-cooked meal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{家庭|かてい}{料理|りょうり}→家庭料理：17474_kateiryouri⟧: home cooking (focuses on the type of cuisine)
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧: handmade (broader, applies to food and other items)
